note: Quantity keys, units and physical bounds. quantity_rules.schema.json enforces exactly these; a test keeps the two identical. Extend only through a contract PR. Unit '1' means dimensionless.

flame_spread_rate.description: Rate of flame front advance over a solid fuel surface.

extinction_oxygen_mole_fraction.description: Lowest oxygen mole fraction at which a flame was sustained, as reported.

ignition_delay.description: Time from ignition energy onset to sustained flame, as defined by the source.

flame_length.description: Flame length as defined by the source.

flame_temperature.description: Flame or gas temperature as reported by the source.

initial_droplet_diameter.description: Droplet diameter at the source-defined time zero, as reported (FLEX: when the igniters are turned on). A droplet size, not a flame size.

visible_flame_extinction_diameter.description: Droplet diameter at the moment the visible flame extinguished, as reported by the source. A droplet size, not a flame size. Defined only for tests that ended in extinction.

burning_rate_constant.description: Droplet burning-rate constant K: the rate of decrease of droplet diameter squared with time (slope of D^2 versus t), as reported by the source. Not a flame spread rate; never interchangeable with flame_spread_rate.

burn_time.description: Duration of burning, as defined and reported by the source.
